'''2007 New Jersey State Championship Andrew Simon DS Let Them Make The First Move''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Andrew Simon]] at [[2007 New Jersey State Championship]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Let Them Make The First Move / At Last We Will Have Revenge|Ref3-D-letthemmakethefirstmove.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' Admiral Ackbar's Demise
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS12]]
